doctrine.statement: The development gate is LAYERED. A fast event tier gates every merge; scheduled deeper tiers run on their own declared triggers. Every tier declares the capabilities it COVERS and, for every capability it does not cover, an explicit DEFERRAL naming the tier that does cover it and why. A capability that is neither covered nor deferred is a silent hole and is refused. Nothing is quarantined without an owner and an expiry, and an expired quarantine fails the gate rather than ageing quietly.
doctrine.pr_tier_content_frozen_by: P7.7 — the pull-request tier's lanes, fixtures, representative case and aggregation are unchanged by the tier split; only the tier DECLARATION check was added to it.

capabilities.statement: Every selected portable registry test is started and terminally reported exactly once on the exact candidate head, with immutable per-test logs and no missing or duplicate test identity.
The actual independently built archive is downloaded without a source checkout and its public bootstrap, real installed capability receipt and independent oracle evidence are retained together.
The merge-compatibility checkout role and the package/source compile identity are recorded and bound SEPARATELY into the complete matrix, so a merge-test result can never be read as a package claim.
Two independent clean candidate-head jobs build package A and B with the same explicit SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, and every path, type, mode, size, file byte and archive byte must agree.
Every workflow file is linted read-only with pinned action SHAs, while every required exact-head multiline shell uses pipefail and no required job masks failure through continue-on-error.
This register is validated on every pull request: complete capability coverage, every deferral declared and resolvable, and no quarantine without an owner, without an expiry, or past its expiry.

The exact candidate head runs the registered mutation compiler, reports measured and unmeasured suite counts honestly, refuses measured survivors, and requires the P0 mutation set to be fully measured and PASS.
An always-run final job consumes all ten independently retained prerequisite receipts and can mint only a non-promotional exact-head development attestation with exact source and artifact joins.
The registered generated-case cohort suite at its ci_default volume — 300 seeded cases, every declared dimension value reached, seed registry replayed.
The generated-case cohort at the declared pr volume — 2,500 seeded cases from the same declared root seed.
The generated-case cohort at the declared nightly volume — 10,000 seeded cases.
The generated-case cohort at the declared weekly volume — 25,000 seeded cases.

The 32 frozen synthetic recipes compiled and driven through the FULL emit pipeline (two clean builds, sidecars, emitted xlsx, formulas, style, cache parity, independent finance, determinism, dynamic geometry) by scripts/run_frozen_cohort.mjs.

Each scheduled tier retains its own verdict JSON as a dated artifact with at least 90 days of retention, so volume, property-assertion count and defect count are readable over time instead of only in a live log.

tiers.title: Pull-request merge-compatibility tier
tiers.speed_contract: This tier gates each pull-request candidate head through twelve separately owned jobs; independent packages and mutation measurement run in parallel while the final always-run aggregate consumes their immutable evidence.

defers.reason: The registered cohort suite's default slice IS this tier's declared cohort content; widening the volume here would change the frozen pull-request content set. The 2,500-case volume is a wider reach over the same declared space and belongs to a scheduled tier.
Ten thousand cases widen seed reach rather than adding a new property; per-merge feedback does not improve, so the volume runs nightly.
The widest declared volume; deferred one tier beyond nightly so nightly keeps a bounded wall clock.
Thirty-two full emit-pipeline cases need LibreOffice, two clean builds each and the Python oracles; that is a scheduled cost, not a per-merge one.
A trend needs repeated runs at a fixed cadence; a pull-request run happens at an arbitrary time against an arbitrary SHA and is not a trend point.

tiers.title: Nightly deep tier
tiers.speed_contract: Scheduled, so wall clock is bounded by the declared job timeouts rather than by merge latency.

defers.reason: The exact-once matrix gates every merge; re-running it nightly would duplicate the merge gate without adding a fact this tier is here to find.
Custody enumeration is a per-SHA statement and is already authoritative on every merge.
There is no merge candidate on a schedule; the merge-versus-package distinction only has meaning on a pull request.
Sharding equivalence is a property of the pull-request tier's own lane split, which this tier does not use.
The workflow lint is a source property; it is proved on the SHA that changes the workflow, which is a pull request.
This register must be healthy before a merge lands, so its check belongs to the merge gate; the scheduled tiers consume the register they were merged with.
Mutation measurement is source-bound exact-head evidence and is retained on every pull request; scheduled volume tiers do not alter that measurement claim.
The all-needs external attestation binds one pull-request candidate head, so a scheduled cohort run cannot reproduce or replace that event-specific evidence.
The 300-case slice is strictly inside the volumes this tier runs; it is covered per merge and not repeated here as a separate claim.
Keeps the nightly wall clock inside its declared 150-minute budget.

not_claimed: seed rotation — every scheduled tier generates from the SAME declared root seed 7730000, so a deeper volume is a WIDER prefix of one deterministic sequence, not a fresh sample

tiers.title: Weekly widest-volume tier
tiers.speed_contract: Scheduled weekly; one job, one declared volume.

defers.reason: Gated on every merge; a weekly repeat adds no new fact.
Per-SHA statement, authoritative on every merge.
No merge candidate exists on a schedule.
A property of the pull-request tier's lane split, which this tier does not use.
A source property proved on the SHA that changes the workflow.
Must be healthy before the merge lands, so it is checked at the merge gate.
Mutation measurement belongs to the exact pull-request source identity; the weekly volume tier neither widens nor substitutes for its measured mutation corpus.
The final external attestation joins ten artifacts from one pull-request event and cannot be recreated by a weekly source-volume execution.
Strictly inside this tier's volume and already covered per merge.
Covered nightly; a weekly repeat of a smaller volume adds nothing this tier's own volume does not.
Covered nightly at a cadence that finds a regression in this volume six days sooner than a weekly repeat would.
A nightly cadence detects a frozen-cohort regression six days sooner than this tier could.

not_claimed: seed rotation — the same declared root seed 7730000 is used, so this is the widest prefix of one deterministic sequence

quarantine.statement: A quarantined job still RUNS and still retains its evidence; only its verdict is non-blocking, and only until the declared expiry. On or after the expiry the tier check refuses, which fails the pull-request gate. An authoritative capability can never be quarantined.

retired.reason: Un-darkening scripts/run_frozen_cohort.mjs surfaced pre-existing, seed-independent defects that make the frozen 32-recipe cohort UNCOMPILABLE at HEAD, so the nightly job is red on its first run. Defect 1: scripts/compile_synthetic_cohort.mjs:1041 seals consensus contributors in the fixed house order [Northstar Securities, Harbour Lane Research, Moorland Capital] while scripts/lib/broker_consensus.mjs:85-92 requires them unique AND canonically sorted, so every case fails validateCaseShape with 'Broker consensus membership contributors must be unique and canonically ordered'. Defect 2, proved by re-running the compiler with defect 1 patched in a throwaway probe copy: C1 then fails forecast-authority validation with 'change_in_working_capital has mixed aggregate forecast ownership in period 1: parent method broker_consensus coexists with live children wc_receivables:explicit_zero, wc_inventory:explicit_zero, wc_payables:explicit_zero'. Both are in scripts/compile_synthetic_cohort.mjs, which P7.7 may not edit. The job is WIRED and RUNS; only its verdict is non-blocking, and only until the declared expiry.
retired.repair: At least two independent repairs in scripts/compile_synthetic_cohort.mjs, REPORTED not performed: (1) sort the contributor list at :1041 ([...names].sort()) so the seal satisfies broker_consensus.mjs:85-92; (2) stop the compiler emitting explicit_zero working-capital children under a broker_consensus change_in_working_capital parent (either give the parent derived_from_children authority or leave the children unstated). Defect 2 is not a one-liner and is the reason this quarantine exists rather than a same-package fix.
retired.receipt: RETIRED 2026-08-21 by agent/mp-C-quarantine-truth after the frozen 32-recipe cohort compiled clean end to end (node scripts/run_ci_gate_tier_tests.mjs --emit-frozen-manifest, then node scripts/compile_synthetic_cohort.mjs <manifest> --bases test-fixtures/cases: status PASS, expected 32, emitted 32, schema_valid 32, coverage_ready 32, solver_pass 32, descriptor_conformance 32). Repairs performed in scripts/compile_synthetic_cohort.mjs: (1) defect 1 as reported - makeThreeHouseBrokerPack sorts the house roster once so the sealed contributor list satisfies scripts/lib/broker_consensus.mjs unique+canonically-sorted membership; consensus maths averages included houses, so ordering never moves a synthesised value. (2) defect 2 as reported - addWorkingChildren's reported-parent branch now declares explicit stand-down forecast authorities (method not_applicable, source_kind none) on each visible working-capital child instead of leaving blanks for the legacy inference to mint into live explicit_zero forecasts under a broker_consensus parent. (3) BEYOND THE REPORTED SCOPE, surfaced only after (1)+(2): the loss-restatement overlay stood its component children down under an accounting_identity combined parent, which forecast-authority validation refuses as incomplete children-owned forecast authority; repaired by leaving each component child live with a revenue-scaled roll-forward (forecast_treatment formula, prior_period_scaled_by [own row_id, revenue]) so the family stays child-owned and the restated combined total reconciles exactly. (4) BEYOND THE REPORTED SCOPE, first failure at C22: the multi-category-capex overlay had mixed ownership of the same family - broker_consensus-reported_parent capex coexisting with live explicit_zero children capex_maintenance/capex_growth/capex_intangible; repaired with the same explicit stand-down-authority declaration as (2). No further member of this defect family surfaced: C23-C32 compiled clean on the next run. COSMETIC CORRECTION to the reason text: it says the cohort fails at C1 with the change_in_working_capital error once defect 1 is patched; the actual first failure after patching defect 1 was C3 (C1 and C2 pass), same error signature. The defects were seed-independent as claimed. The nightly job's verdict returns to blocking on its next scheduled run.
